conservative_fusion.interpretation: The conservative fusion covariance deliberately retains the existing SG-overlap uncertainty and adds the uncentered empirical residual score second moment without subtracting the SG contribution. It is intended as a conservative fusion distribution, not as a calibrated generative noise covariance.
